notes:
Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter, Zaiqa Kitchen and Zaiqa Stock apps, version 2.29.0.

New: Zaiqa Stock app for your stock keepers
• A new phone app, "Zaiqa Stock": opening count, live stock, Stock In, Wastage and closing count - replaces the paper register
• Works only on the shop Wi-Fi and only while a POS shift is open; each person has their own name + PIN (POS > Management > Stock App)
• Every sale cuts stock automatically from your recipes; items without a recipe are counted and their usage is worked out at closing
• New POS screens: Stock Sheet (live, with PDF/Telegram and history), Stock Items (quick add your whole register at once, categories) and Stock App (staff, rules)
• Ingredients now have a Category, so the Stock app shows them category-wise
• The cashier is warned when ending a shift if the closing count has not been submitted
